messages:
Maya (AE): Starting a focused thread for Mercury Bank POC: delegated domain verification, SCIM whitelist, SAML mapping, and shared-contract billing. Short answers appreciated. :blush:
Raj (Mercury IT): Hi — corporate wants single invoice but each subsidiary must retain admin control and only manage their domain. Also SCIM must not provision every directory user.
Ethan (SE): We can support delegated domain ownership via per-namespace DNS TXT tokens (preferred) or email verification to an admin alias. Example TXT: `_rdw-verify=mx73c2`. Use `dig TXT _rdw-verify.subsidiary.mercurybank.com` after adding.
Claire (Security): Please confirm we never ask for DNS admin creds. Also need to know whether SAML assertions are stored raw anywhere.
Ethan (SE): We never request DNS admin credentials. For SAML, we log assertion metadata (issuer, timestamp, success/failure) but do not persist full raw assertions by default.
Raj (Mercury IT): Good. For SCIM we need a whitelist so only netops/app-admins/audit groups create accounts. Can you enforce server-side filtering?
Ethan (SE): Yes — IdP-level filtering + a server-side provisioning whitelist. We'll ship a sample filter config for Okta/AD. Link-only vs create-on-provision?
Maya (AE): Legal prefers link-only for high-risk subsidiaries; ops teams may want create-on-provision elsewhere.
Ethan (SE): Both supported. We'll include a flag in the onboarding checklist per namespace. Link-only returns 404 for unknown users; create-on-provision POSTs the user.
billing-bot: Single-contract billing supported. We report token and embedding usage per namespace; reserved-capacity discounts apply at contract level and can be allocated pro-rata to subsidiaries. Finance will request steady-state tokens/day and peak rps.
Claire (Security): Action: I'll send a 1-page security FAQ (KMS, in-transit TLS ciphers, HSM options for Private, audit log residency). Also clarify retention controls: Hosted needs add-on for long retention; Dedicated/Private support configurable per-namespace.
Raj (Mercury IT): Can you provide a quick curl sample to test SCIM link-only? Our IdP team will run it.
Ethan (SE): Sure — sample below:
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -d '{"userName":"lee.ops@subs.mercurybank.com","emails":[{"value":"lee.ops@subs.mercurybank.com"}],"externalId":"ext-789"}'
```
Maya (AE): Thanks all  I'll bundle the SAML metadata, DNS token instructions, SCIM whitelist sample, security FAQ, and billing template and send to Raj. POC kickoff Fri 14:00 UTC. :calendar:
